root.label: Warner Bros. TV sends cease-and-desist over The Vow promotion

events.label: Warner Bros. TV sends cease-and-desist over The Vow promotion

slots.name: date sent
slots.sentence: Warner Bros. TV sent Fox News Media and Lionsgate a cease-and-desist letter Sept. 18 over a promotional video for "The Vow," an upcoming faith-based dating series helmed by Chris Harrison, the former host of ABC's "The Bachelor."
